repertoire_probe_source: Recorded fixed neutral state / shared point model; endpoint geometry only, encounter safety is in symmetric probes

checkpoint_competency.scope: nominal point-model motion competence; no obstacle or task safety guarantee

summary.emergency_rule: Same obstacle-agnostic model-aware velocity braking and attitude stabilization; explicitly uncertified, midpoint only invalid resources.

event_state_competency.scope: nominal point-model motion competence; no obstacle or task safety guarantee

feasibility_reference.arena_scope: center position with the same explicit arena clearance as the safety filter
feasibility_reference.interpretation: success proves one sampled numerical route; failure does not prove impossibility
feasibility_reference.purpose: known-model physically achievable detour witness; not a PL-CBF certificate

hover_authority_after_change.scope: upright collective vertical authority only; excludes horizontal trim and evasion

adaptive.failure_sequence: Recorded events are chronology, not proof that every safe control was impossible.

compensated.failure_sequence: Recorded events are chronology, not proof that every safe control was impossible.

fixed.failure_sequence: Recorded events are chronology, not proof that every safe control was impossible.

post_event_compensation.scope: Shared nominal pre-event actor; the compensated branches enable identical point-model force feedforward at the event. Compare compensated versus adaptive to isolate subsequent BPTT updates.

summary.runtime_scope: Measured sequential GPU service, paced control boundaries, next-boundary completed-snapshot publication; sensor/actuator transport latency excluded. Diagnostic probes run afterward.
